name: Boring
fun_fact: Boring is sister cities with Dull, Scotland and Bland, Australia — forming the most underwhelming international alliance in history.

name: Intercourse
fun_fact: Founded in 1754, locals have learned to spell out their address very carefully when ordering online.

name: Ding Dong
fun_fact: Named after twin brothers Zulius and Bert Bell, whose general store sign featured two bells — not the snack cake. Probably.

name: Why
fun_fact: Named for the Y-shaped intersection of two highways. Arizona law required town names to have at least three letters, so 'Y' became 'Why.' Good enough.

name: Embarrass
fun_fact: Holds the record for the coldest temperature ever recorded in the contiguous US at -60°F. The town's name suddenly makes sense.

name: Burnt Corn
fun_fact: Named after a Creek Indian battle in 1813. Despite the dramatic origin story, it mostly comes up in jokes about bad cooking.

name: Hooker
fun_fact: Named after a homesteader named Hooker. The town leans in hard — their high school team is called the Hookers and they love every second of it.

name: Toad Suck
fun_fact: Legend says it was named for a tavern where boatmen would 'suck on the bottle until they swelled up like toads.' They hold an annual Toad Suck Daze festival.

name: Nimrod
fun_fact: Named after the biblical hunter. The town is very small, very quiet, and extremely committed to their name.

name: Lonelyville
fun_fact: Located on Fire Island. Somehow this name did not discourage real estate development. People pay a lot of money to summer in Lonelyville.

name: Accident
fun_fact: Named after two surveyors accidentally staked the same plot of land in 1750. Their legal dispute was resolved. The name was not.

name: Spread Eagle
fun_fact: A former mining and logging town. The post office reportedly receives a suspicious amount of mail from people who just want the postmark.

name: Normal
fun_fact: Named after a 'normal school' — an old term for a teachers college. Illinois State University is there. Nothing about it is particularly normal.

name: Weed
fun_fact: Named after Abner Weed, who founded a lumber mill there in 1897. Gift shop sales have increased dramatically since 2016.

name: Truth or Consequences
fun_fact: Renamed in 1950 after a radio game show offered to broadcast from any town that changed its name to match. Hot Springs, NM took the deal. No regrets.

name: Chicken
fun_fact: Residents wanted to name it Ptarmigan after the local bird, but couldn't agree on the spelling. Chicken was the compromise. Population: 7.

name: Coward
fun_fact: Named after the Coward family who settled there. Locals are apparently very brave about it.

name: Okay
fun_fact: Incorporated in 1919. When asked how things are going in Okay, Oklahoma, residents have the most accurate answer of anyone in America.
